ThingDef.label: command protocol
ThingDef.description:
An ancient Necron cranial node that encodes hard-wired dominance directives into the bearer's neural engrams, allowing direct command over Necron war constructs. Those who bear the command protocol are known as Necron Overlords.

The node is self-installing. Pressed against the base of the skull, it fuses with the living metal of the host's nervous system and threads command-band frequencies through the necrodermis framework.

Unlike crude mechanoid links, the command protocol does not merely send radio signals — it enforces the absolute unity and obedience of the Necron race through hard-coded directives etched sixty million years ago. The bond between Overlord and construct is not cooperation; it is compulsion.

The protocol is integrated at the core engram level and cannot be removed while the bearer lives.

Note: A bearer of the command protocol must be capable of smithing work to gestate Necron constructs.
